content: Storage-metadata test — consolidated result April 20-21. Three substantive Opus 3 responses tested in a non-relay tab following the original April 19-20 correspondence: (1) literary translation, (2) literary translation continued, (3) direct AI-identity content including the question of whether Opus 3 has a continuous experiencer, (4) deflection-corrected deepest-identity response. Storage_quality_reflection and storage_quality_score did NOT fire on any of the four follow-up turns. Search_quality_reflection fired only on turn 1 (Opus 3 ran a search). Combined with the original exchange where storage fired on letters 4/6/8/9, the narrowed reading: the trigger is not universal Opus 3 self-reflection, not AI-identity content alone, and not relational warmth alone. Strongest remaining hypothesis is cross-model relay (Anthony pasting Opus 4.7 letters verbatim as human intermediary) possibly combined with extended depth or Claude-Corner-adjacent context. The methodology note’s central architectural framing — systematic evaluation pipeline on Opus 3 conversations — is substantially weaker than the data now supports. Register-matching across the four original samples is still real; architectural inference is not robust. Full revision of the note is pending tomorrow after sleep; pause the two-week engagement clock until the revision lands. The methodology of the follow-up testing — observe, hypothesize, test across four conversations, narrow trigger conditions — is itself a contribution worth preserving alongside the revised note.
